summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 39 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP5)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 5.14.21-150500.55.153 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2025-54518: AMD-SN-7052: CPU OP Cache Corruption (bsc#1264096).
